topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 113 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 27 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 48 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, xerc20). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
